追償登入 做一次後 只能做 追償處理
compensate 尾00的 推測是為了卡追償，做了一輪後會產出00 估計是AS400追償後
select c.REPLEVYFLAG,c.* from prplclaim c,prplregist r 
	where r.registno = c.registno and c.endcasedate is not null 
		and c.canceldate is null  and c.claimNo='185023BL000104' 
		and c.replevyFlag = '0'  AND (1 = 1) 	
	replevyFlag==1
		query select * from  PrpLcompensate WHERE  compensateNo like 'R立案號%' order by compensateNo
		尾數00 包括00只有一筆
			UnderWriteFlag 是0 >>HasReplevy=1  >>>>>該案件已登錄未處理，不可再次登錄
			UnderWriteFlag 不是0 >>HasReplevy=3 >>>>>>該案件追償協商處理中，不可再次登錄 
		尾數00 包括00大於一筆
			HasReplevy=2 >>>>>>> 該案件追償處理進行中，不可再次登錄
	replevyFlag==0
		query claimno = '185023BL000104' and compensateno ='R立案號00'
		有資料就回傳>>>>>該賠案已追償登錄

00那筆如果要做追償處理 須把compensate的 underWriteFlag 初始化 0 <<似乎AS400會回寫成0 使之初始化

4.	C4(32)：賠償金額 = 核定賠償 × 肇事責任比率 - 自負額

--流程查詢查的到因為找尋較單純 基本QUERY 加上 結束跟正常流轉的判斷
SELECT * FROM PRPLCOMPENSATE p WHERE p.COMPENSATENO = 'C180024MIL0031301'
-------------------

--未處理理算任務
SELECT *
FROM   swflog
WHERE  nodetype = 'compe'
       AND EXISTS (SELECT 0
                   FROM   prplregistrpolicy p
                   WHERE  swflog.registno = p.registno
                          AND policyno = '180024MI0041913')
       AND ( nodestatus = '0' )
       --AND ( handlercode = 'CF044' OR handlercode = '0' )
       AND ( flowstatus = '1' OR flowstatus = '2' )
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 0
                       FROM   swflog s
                       WHERE  swflog.keyin = s.keyin
                              AND nodetype = 'cance'
                              AND nodestatus = '0')
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 0
                       FROM   prplcompensate
                       WHERE  swflog.keyin = prplcompensate.claimno
                              AND ( prplcompensate.compensateno LIKE 'C%'
                                     OR prplcompensate.compensateno LIKE 'D%' )
                              AND prplcompensate.underwriteflag <> '1'
                              AND prplcompensate.underwriteflag <> '3')
       AND ( 1 = 1 )
ORDER  BY flowintime 
------------------------------------
--未處理理算任務 找不到的原因
SELECT p.REGISTNO,p.* FROM prplregistrpolicy p WHERE p.policyno = '180024MI0041913'
SELECT * FROM BUSINESS.SWFLOG s WHERE nodetype = 'compe' AND s.REGISTNO = '6MI000000000240000257' --這段就查不到
------------------------------------
--已處理理算任務 找不到的原因
SELECT *
FROM   swflog
WHERE  nodetype = 'compp'
       AND policyno = '180024MI0041913'
       AND ( nodestatus = '4' )
       AND ( handlercode = 'CF044'
              OR handlercode = '0' )
       AND ( flowstatus = '1'
              OR flowstatus = '2' )
       AND ( 1 = 1 )
ORDER  BY submittime DESC 

基本上
SELECT *
FROM   swflog
WHERE  nodetype = 'compp'
       AND policyno = '180024MI0041913'
	   這段就找不到了

以下都用"請~"這串自來觸發請求，並將以下全部內容變成一個預存程序，傳入三個參數 FLOWINTIME起訖以及UNIFORMNO
請~幫我把下面這個SQL 組合出全部回傳的COMPENSATENO

--找出這批 COMPENSATENO
select payobj_.COMPENSATENO,payobj_.* from BUSINESS.PRPLPAYOBJECTINFO payobj_ RIGHT JOIN (--看數據
	select wflog_step1.* from BUSINESS.WFLOG wflog0_ RIGHT JOIN (
		SELECT *  FROM  (  
				SELECT   DISTINCT WFLOG.*   
				FROM   BUSINESS.WFLOG   WHERE  
				(  (  WFLOG.NODENO <= 5   AND (  1 = 1   AND (  WFLOG.CLASSCODE IN ('A', 'B') OR WFLOG.RISKCODE IN ('A01')  )  )  )  )   
				AND WFLOG.LOGNO <> 1   AND WFLOG.NODENO <> 1   AND (    WFLOG.BUSINESSTYPE = 'C' OR WFLOG.BUSINESSTYPE = 'Y'  )   
				AND RISKCATEGORY = 'D'  AND RISKCODE IN('A01')   AND NODESTATUS IN('0','1','2','3')  
				AND FLOWINTIME >= '2025-09-11 00:00:00'   --起日
				AND FLOWINTIME <= '2025-09-18 23:59:59'   --訖日
			)   
		WHERE (OPERATORCODE IS NULL OR OPERATORCODE = 'BL011' --登入的人
				)  ORDER BY FLOWINTIME DESC 
	) wflog_step1 ON wflog0_.FLOWID = wflog_step1.FLOWID AND wflog0_.LOGNO=wflog_step1.LOGNO
) wflogStep2 ON payobj_.COMPENSATENO = wflogStep2.businessNo 
			AND payobj_.UNIFORMNO='16784078' --統編
			AND payobj_.PAYCODETYPE='1' --類別
WHERE payobj_.COMPENSATENO IS NOT NULL

SELECT
RM.GOID,
RM.PAYACOUNTNAME,
RM.CLAIMNO,
RM.POLICYNO,
RM.INSUREDNAME,
CONVERT(VARCHAR ,RM.DAMAGEDATE,111) DAMAGEDATE,
CONVERT(VARCHAR ,RM.CLMPAYDATE,111) CLMPAYDATE,
RM.PAYMETHOD,
RM.PAYBANKNAME,
RM.PAYACOUNT,
REPLACE(CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), CONVERT(MONEY, RM.CLMPAY+RM.CLMFEE), 1), '.00', '') CLMPAY,
RM.HANDLERNAME,
CRD.RD_COUNT,
CRD.KINDCLMFEE
FROM AS400DB.dbo.CTBC_CLMSMS_RM RM
LEFT JOIN
(SELECT COUNT(0) RD_COUNT, GOID, KINDCLMFEE  FROM AS400DB.dbo.CTBC_CLMSMS_RD  GROUP BY GOID,KINDCLMFEE ) CRD
ON RM.GOID = CRD.GOID
WHERE 1=1
AND RM.MSGSENDMARK IS NULL
AND convert(nvarchar(50), RM.GOID) = $P{asGOID};

function checkLoss() {
	//1.检查必须要有一条记录
	if (getRowsCount("ClaimLoss") == 0) {
		errorMessage("估损金额金额信息至少要有一条记录!");

		return false;
	}
	//2币别不能为空的

	for (var j = 1; j < fm.prpLclaimLossCurrency.length; j++) {
		if (isEmptyField(fm.prpLclaimLossCurrency[j])) {
			errorMessage("第" + j + "条估损金额中币别不能为空!");
			return false;
		}
		if (isEmptyField(fm.prpLclaimLossKindCode[j])) {
			errorMessage("第" + j + "条事故估损金额中险别代码不能为空!");
			return false;
		}

		//险别和币别相同的，必须合並
		if (isEmptyField(fm.prpLclaimLossSumClaim[j])) {
			errorMessage("第" + j + "条事故估损金额中金额不能为空!");
			return false;
		}
	}
	return checkBeyondSumAmount();
}




function checkBeyondSumAmount() {
	var flag = true;
	var errorMessage = "";
	debugger;
	var $Amount = $("#ClaimLoss").find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossAmount']");
	var $LossFeeType = $("#ClaimLoss").find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossLossFeeType']");
	var $KindCode = $("#ClaimLoss").find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossKindCode']");
	var $ItemKindNo = $("#ClaimLoss").find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossItemKindNo']");
	
	//mantis：CLM0231，處理人員：DP0713，需求單編號：新核心-傷害險高保額新商品檢核
	var $riskCode = fm.prpLclaimRiskCode;
	
	var amountArray = new Array();
	var kindCodeArray = new Array();
	var sumClaimArray = new Array();
	var payoutTimeArray = new Array();
	var kindCodes = "";
	$("#ClaimLoss").find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossSumClaim']").each(function(i,n){
		if(!$.isNumeric(n.value)){
			n.value = "0";
		}
		if (parseFloat(n.value) < 0) {
			errorMessage += "第"+(i+1)+"條"+i18n.claim.lessZero; // 估损金额不能小於零
			flag = false;
			return flag;
		}
		var $sumClaimList = $(":input[name='"+$KindCode[i].value +"_"+ $ItemKindNo[i].value+"']");
		$Amount[i].value = $sumClaimList.val();
		var $span = $sumClaimList.parents("span[name='spanPayoutTime']");
		var $payoutTime = $span.find(":input[name='payoutTime']");
		if($LossFeeType.get(i).value=="P"){
			kindCodes = $KindCode.get(i).value;
			var index = $.inArray(kindCodes, kindCodeArray);
			if(index>-1){
				sumClaimArray[index] += parseFloat(n.value);
			}else{
				kindCodeArray.push(kindCodes);
				amountArray.push(parseFloat($Amount.get(i).value));
				sumClaimArray.push(parseFloat(n.value));
				payoutTimeArray.push($payoutTime.val());
			}
		}
	});
	$.each(kindCodeArray,function(i,n){
		if(payoutTimeArray[i]!="P"&&$.isNumeric(payoutTimeArray[i])){
			//mantis：CLM0231，處理人員：DP0713，需求單編號：新核心-傷害險高保額新商品檢核 START
			if(kindCodeArray[i]=="PAF4"){
				//跳過 PAF4 檢核
				//alert("PAF4");
			}else 
			//mantis：CLM0231，處理人員：DP0713，需求單編號：新核心-傷害險高保額新商品檢核 END
			if(sumClaimArray[i]>amountArray[i]*parseFloat(payoutTimeArray[i])){
				errorMessage += kindCodeArray[i]+"險別賠付預估金額應小於等於 ‘保險金額×保額賠付倍數’請檢核後重新輸入。"; //估损金额不能大於保额
				flag = false;
				return false;
			}
		}
		
	});

	//mantis：CLM0231，處理人員：DP0713，需求單編號：新核心-傷害險高保額新商品檢核 START
	if(undefined!=$riskCode && null!=$riskCode && null!=$riskCode.value && $riskCode.value=="PA"){
		var errorMessageForHospitalize="";
		var prpLcompensateHospitalizedDays = fm.prpLclaimHospitalizedDays;
		var totalPAFamount = 0;
		
		var PAF456_SUMLOSS = undefined!=fm.PAF456_SUMLOSS && null!=fm.PAF456_SUMLOSS && ""!=fm.PAF456_SUMLOSS.value?fm.PAF456_SUMLOSS.value:0.0;
		var PAF7_AMOUNT = undefined!=fm.PAF7_AMOUNT && null!=fm.PAF7_AMOUNT && ""!=fm.PAF7_AMOUNT.value?fm.PAF7_AMOUNT.value:0.0;
		
		debugger;
		$.each(kindCodeArray,function(i,n){
			if(payoutTimeArray[i]!="P"&&$.isNumeric(payoutTimeArray[i])){
				
				if(kindCodeArray[i]=="PAF4"){
					prpLclaimHospitalizedDays = prpLcompensateHospitalizedDays.value;//本次住院天數
					if(undefined!=prpLcompensateHospitalizedDays && null!=prpLcompensateHospitalizedDays 
							&& ""==prpLcompensateHospitalizedDays.value && !(isNaN(prpLcompensateHospitalizedDays.value))){
						if(""!=errorMessageForHospitalize){
							errorMessageForHospitalize+="\r\n";
						}
						errorMessageForHospitalize +="請輸入本次住院天數";
						flag = false;
					}else{
						totalPAFamount += parseInt(amountArray[i],10)*parseFloat(prpLclaimHospitalizedDays); 
						if(sumClaimArray[i]>amountArray[i]*parseFloat(prpLclaimHospitalizedDays)){
							if(""!=errorMessageForHospitalize){
								errorMessageForHospitalize+="\r\n";
							}
//							errorMessageForHospitalize += kindCodeArray[i]+"險別賠付預估金額("+sumClaimArray[i]+")應小於等於("+amountArray[i]+")X("+parseFloat(prpLclaimHospitalizedDays)+")="+amountArray[i]*parseFloat(prpLclaimHospitalizedDays)+" ‘本次住院天數×保險日額’請檢核後重新輸入。"; //估损金额不能大於保额
							errorMessageForHospitalize += kindCodeArray[i]+"險別賠付預估金額應小於等於 ‘本次住院天數×保險金額’，請檢核後重新輸入。"; //估损金额不能大於保额
							flag = false;
						}
					}
				}
				if(kindCodeArray[i]=="PAF5"){
					totalPAFamount += parseInt(sumClaimArray[i],10);
					if(sumClaimArray[i]>amountArray[i]){
						if(""!=errorMessageForHospitalize){
							errorMessageForHospitalize+="\r\n";
						}
						errorMessageForHospitalize += kindCodeArray[i]+"險別賠付預估金額應小於等於 "+kindCodeArray[i]+"‘保險金額’，請檢核後重新輸入。"; //估损金额不能大於保额
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if(kindCodeArray[i]=="PAF6"){
					totalPAFamount += parseInt(sumClaimArray[i],10);
					if(sumClaimArray[i]>amountArray[i]){
						if(""!=errorMessageForHospitalize){
							errorMessageForHospitalize+="\r\n";
						}
						errorMessageForHospitalize += kindCodeArray[i]+"險別賠付預估金額應小於等於 "+kindCodeArray[i]+"‘保險金額’，請檢核後重新輸入。"; //估损金额不能大於保额
						flag = false;
					}
				}
				if(kindCodeArray[i]=="PAF7"){
					if(""!=errorMessageForHospitalize){
						errorMessageForHospitalize+="\r\n";
					}
					errorMessageForHospitalize += kindCodeArray[i]+"險別不應存在’請刪除後重新送出。"; //PAF7 找保單要
					flag = false;
				}給我左邊查詢出來的超連結
			}
		});
		debugger;
		if((parseInt(totalPAFamount,10)+parseInt(PAF456_SUMLOSS,10)) > parseInt(PAF7_AMOUNT,10)){
//			errorMessageForHospitalize+= "\r\n已經核賠("+PAF456_SUMLOSS+")本次預計給付金額("+totalPAFamount+")的加總("+(parseInt(totalPAFamount,10)+parseInt(PAF456_SUMLOSS,10))+")超過 (>) 保單("+fm.policyno.value+")金額估損總金額("+PAF7_AMOUNT+")。";
			errorMessageForHospitalize+= "\r\n本次預計給付金額的加總超過保單金額估損總金額 ，請檢核後重新輸入。";
			flag = false;
		}
		if(""!=errorMessageForHospitalize){
			errorMessage = errorMessageForHospitalize;//PA優先先出這個錯誤訊息
		}
	}
	//mantis：CLM0231，處理人員：DP0713，需求單編號：新核心-傷害險高保額新商品檢核 END
	
	if(errorMessage != ""){
		alert(errorMessage);
	}
	return flag;
}

function setPaymentType_24_30(field){
	var $tr = $(field).parents("tr[name='prpLpersonFeeLossPaymentTr']");
	var $kindCode = $tr.find(":input[name='prpLpersonLossKindCode']");
	var $prpLpersonLossItemKindNo = $tr.find(":input[name='prpLpersonLossItemKindNo']");
	var $itemKindNo = $("span[name='span_prpCitemKind']").find(":input[name='itemKindNo'][value='"+$prpLpersonLossItemKindNo.val()+"']");
	if($itemKindNo.length>0){
		var $span_prpCitemKind = $itemKindNo.parent();
		var commodityCode = $span_prpCitemKind.find(":input[name='commodityCode']").val();
		$tr.find(":input[name='prpLpersonLossAmount']").val($span_prpCitemKind.find(":input[name='amount']").val());<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<<
		var $paymentType = $tr.find(":input[name='prpLpersonLossPaymentType']");
		var $paymentType1 = $tr.find(":input[name='prpLpersonLossPaymentType1']");
		var $paymentType2 = $tr.find(":input[name='prpLpersonLossPaymentType2']");
		if(commodityCode.length>4){
			if(commodityCode.substring(3,5)=="24"||commodityCode.substring(3,5)=="30"){
				setPaymentTypeReadonly($paymentType.get(0),false);
				clearPaymentType($paymentType.get(0),"paymentType");
			}else{
				setPaymentTypeReadonly($paymentType.get(0),true);
				$paymentType.val("23");
				setCacheValue($paymentType.get(0));
				$paymentType1.val("2300");
				setCacheValue($paymentType1.get(0));
				$paymentType2.val("0000");
				setCacheValue($paymentType2.get(0));
//				$tr.find(":input[name='prpLpersonLossSumRealPay']").attr("readonly",false);
				$tr.find(":input[name='prpLpersonLossContractingScope']").val("23");
				var url = contextRootPath+"/common/verificationPaymentType.do";
				var contractingScope = 23;
				var paymentType = $paymentType.val();
				var paymentType1 = $paymentType1.val();
				var paymentType2 = $paymentType2.val();
				var codeType ="paymentType2";
				$.ajax({
					type:"get",
			 		url:url,
			 		cache:false,
			 		dataType:"json",
			 		data:"contractingScope="+contractingScope+"&paymentType="+paymentType+"&paymentType1="+paymentType1+"&paymentType2="+paymentType2+"&codeType="+codeType,
					success:function(data){
						if(data.message=="true"){
							setPaymentType2(data,field);
						}
					}
				});
			}
		}else{
			setPaymentTypeReadonly(field,false);
			clearPaymentType(field,"paymentType");
		}
	}
	
}

function getAmount(field){
	var $tr = $(field).parents("tr[name='prpLpersonFeeLossPaymentTr']");
	var $itemKindNo = $tr.find(":input[name='prpLpersonLossItemKindNo']");
	var amount = 0;
	if($itemKindNo.val()!=""){
		var $span_prpCitemKind = $("span[name='span_prpCitemKind']").find(":input[name='itemKindNo'][value='"+$itemKindNo.val()+"']").parent();
		var $amount= $span_prpCitemKind.find(":input[name='amount']");
		var $coverageratio= $span_prpCitemKind.find(":input[name='coverageratio']");
		var coverageratio = "1";
		if($coverageratio.length > 0 && $coverageratio.val().length > 0){
			coverageratio = parseInt($coverageratio.val());
		}
		amount = $parseFloat($amount.val()) * coverageratio;
	}
	if(amount==0){
		amount = $parseFloat($(":input[name='prpLcompensateSumAmount']").val());
	}
	return amount;
}

/***
	 * 強制險醫療給付費用資訊

	function insertMedicalDetail(btnFeild){
		
		$("#PrpLpersonLoss").find("tr[name='prpLpersonLossObject']").each(function (i, prpLpersonLossObject) {
			var flag=$(prpLpersonLossObject).find(".flag");
			if("1"!=flag.val()){
				flag.parents("prpLpersonFeeLossObject").remove();
			}
		});
		var compensateNo = $(":input[name='prpLcompensateCompensateNo']").val();
		var claimNo = $(":input[name='prpLcompensateClaimNo']").val();
		var $prpLpersonLossObject = $(btnFeild).closest("tr[name='prpLpersonLossObject']");
		var $prpLpayObjectInfoPaycodeType = document.getElementsByName("prpLpayObjectInfoPaycodeType");
		var prpLpayObjectInfoPaycodeType = $prpLpayObjectInfoPaycodeType[0].value;
		var identifyNumber = $prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonCommerceIdentifyNumber']").val();
		var sex = $prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonCommerceSex']").val();
		var identityOfInjuredPerson = $prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonCommerceIdentityOfInjuredPerson']").val(); //受害人身份
		if (!($.trim(identifyNumber) != '' && (identityOfInjuredPerson != '1' || checkIdentifyNumber(identifyNumber, sex)))) {
			alert("請爲受害人錄入正確的身份證號");
			return ;
		}
		var personNo = $prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonCommerceSerialNo']").val();
		var personName = $prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonCommercePersonName']").val();
		var actionType = $(":input[name='editType']").val();
		var height = 600;
		var width = 1260;
		var url = contextRootPath + "/compensate/beforeInsertMedicalDetail.do?actionType="+actionType+"&claimNo="+claimNo+"&compensateNo="+compensateNo+"&personNo="+personNo+"&identifyNumber="+identifyNumber+"&personName="+personName+"&prpLpayObjectInfoPaycodeType="+prpLpayObjectInfoPaycodeType;
		var returnObj = window.showModalDialog(url, window, "dialogHeight:"+height+"px;dialogWidth:"+width+"px;help:no;resizable:yes;status:no;scroll:yes;");
		if(returnObj){
			$prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonMedicalDetailCode'][value^='A0']").each(function(){
				$(this).closest("tr").remove();
			});
			var PersonFee = returnObj.PersonFee;
			var SumFee = returnObj.SumFee;
			var messages = "";
			if(SumFee && SumFee > 0){
				var sumDefPayA00 = 0;
				var identifyNumber = $prpLpersonLossObject.find("input[name='prpLpersonCommerceIdentifyNumber']").val();
				var $personPay = $("#limitMap").find("input[name$='" + identifyNumber + "']");
				if ($personPay.length > 0) {
					messages += "該受害人其他計算書已賠付:";
					$personPay.each(function () {
						if (this.name.charAt(0) == 'A') {
							sumDefPayA00 += parseFloat(this.value); //医疗加总
							messages += "醫療費用";
						}
						messages += Math.round(this.value) + ";"
					});
					messages += "\n";
				}
				var maxPay = MAXMEDICALPAY ; //醫療費用限額
				var exceedingPayout = $(":input[name='exceedingPayout']").val();
				if (sumDefPayA00 + SumFee > MAXMEDICALPAY) { //校验医疗加总是否超出医疗限额，超出则撤销当前录入
					messages += "當前計算書醫療給付超出限額" + Math.round(sumDefPayA00 + SumFee - MAXMEDICALPAY) + "! (醫療給付限額:" + MAXMEDICALPAY + ")";
					//判断用户是否有超额赔付权限，如果有超额赔付权限，就不控制医疗最高限额20万
					if(exceedingPayout=="true"){
						exceedingPayout = confirm(messages+"\n因您有超額賠付權限：點擊【確定】繼續賠付，點【取消】重新錄入醫療給付費用收據資料！");
						if(!exceedingPayout){
							return ;
						}
					}
					alert(messages + "請重新錄入醫療給付費用收據資料！");
					return ;
				}
				var $PersonFeeMedical = $(btnFeild).parents("table[name='PersonFeeMedical']").children("tbody");
				//設置費用資料
				$.each(PersonFee,function(i,fee){
					var $cloneObject = $("#PersonFeeMedical_Data").find("tr[name='prpLpersonFeeLossObject']").clone(true);
					$PersonFeeMedical.append($cloneObject);
					$cloneObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonMedicalDetailCode']").val(fee.MedicalDetailCode);
					$cloneObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonMedicalDetailName']").val(fee.MedicalDetailName);
					$cloneObject.find(":input[name='medicDeathFlag']").val("M");
					$cloneObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonMedicalSumLoss']").val(fee.MedicalSumLoss);
					$cloneObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonMedicalSumDefPay']").val(fee.MedicalSumDefPay);
				});
				setPersonAndMedicalSerialNo();
				if(returnObj.HealthPoints > 0 || returnObj.HealthAmount > 0){
					$prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonCommerceMedicalCode']").val("Y");
					$prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonCommerceHealthPoints']").val(returnObj.HealthPoints);
					$prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonCommerceHealthAmount']").val(returnObj.HealthAmount);
				}
			} else {
				$prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonCommerceHealthPoints']").val("0");
				$prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonCommerceHealthAmount']").val("0");
			}
			var sumDefPayB00 = $prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLPersonLossB00']").val(); //残废加总
			var sumDefPayC00 = $prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLPersonLossC00']").val(); //死亡加总
			$prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLPersonLossA00']").val(Math.round(SumFee)); //医疗加总
			$prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='prpLpersonCommerceSumRealPay1']").val(Math.round(parseFloat(SumFee) + parseFloat(sumDefPayB00) + parseFloat(sumDefPayC00)));
			//設置人傷
			var $CommerceCasualties1 = $prpLpersonLossObject.find(":input[name='CommerceCasualties'][value='1']");
			$CommerceCasualties1.prop("checked",(SumFee > 0));
			setPersonLossCommerce($CommerceCasualties1[0]);
			//統計賠付
			calFundCommerce();
		}
	}

業務單位業務員執行業務需求功能時，是依證起訖日期執行業務功能，證照日期起迄與新證起訖若遇假日即為下一證期作業順利，業務員會以舊照訖日(下班)前，
更新最新執業證照起訖至最新版本，然而在上述裝況下依然有可能有突發狀況，需要執行業務功能，但舊照起訖已經沒在註冊時間內，而新照時間起日卻還沒開始的處境，
故針對此處境增加上傳功能以及排程執行共預計兩支程式。

目前已經與USER(玉芳)開個小會討論出以下解決方法

--假設的範例------------------------------------
舊證的日期 2011-2-10(略) ~ 2016-2-9(六) 
新的證日期 2016-2-11(一) ~ 2021-2-10(略)
如果人工設定時間 2016-2-8 18:00 下班前設定 由於銷管系統在這個介面下的邏輯是單一資料 無歷程記錄
所以當業務在 2016-2-8 18:01 ~ 2016-2-9 23:59 
這段期間 如果這時間這業務需要作業 則此業務無法執行


--故此-已經與會USER，提出的解決方法，並且已經取得下列共識----
用USER原有Excel物件 於銷管開發一個介面，使得USER上傳 並DB紀錄 
APS則新增一項排程 於系統每日早上將會把已經上傳的資料 以 新證起始日期 作為判斷 與當天日期相同的 
即以key為條件 更新業務員最新的證號起訖日期
以上述範例 於2016-2-11 00:00:00 
排程啟動 抓到這筆資料就會將該業務的證號替換為最新的證號日期 2016-2-11(一) 8:25 上班也正常操作系統
此項更新可以保證 都是在新證的起始日起當天早上排程啟動之時 予以更新
所以依上述範例所演示  2016-2-8 18:01 ~ 2016-2-9 23:59 休假期間即使收到需求需緊急操作業務
此時該業務員依然有原有的執行系統操作權限

文件-撰寫約2個工作天
開發-約略5個工作天 
總時時程SIT->UAT測試->PROD測試 我猜保守點估計反覆個一兩次測試 應該要一個月上線

已經與AS400 呂鴻文討論過 因AS400系統原本就有歷程記錄所以並沒有任何影響不需要額外開發處理

SELECT 
INSURED2NAME --要保人姓名
,POSTADDRESS --要保人通訊地址
,INSURED1NAME --被保險人姓名
,LICENSENO --車號
,BUSINESSNATURE --業務來源
,EXTRACOMCODE --單位
--,LISTAGG(前期任意險保單號碼, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY 前期任意險保單號碼) 　
,LISTAGG(VPLYNO, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY VPLYNO) 　
AS VPLYNO ,--前期任意險保單號碼, 
    --MAX(任意險保到期日) AS 任意險保到期日, 
    MAX(VENDDATE) AS VENDDATE, --任意險保到期日, 
    --LISTAGG(前期強制險保單號碼, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY 前期強制險保單號碼) 
    LISTAGG(CPLYNO, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CPLYNO) 
AS CPLYNO,--前期強制險保單號碼, 
    --MAX(強制險保到期日) AS 強制險保到期日, 
    MAX(CENDDATE) AS CENDDATE,
    --歸屬單位代號, 服務人員員編, 服務人員姓名, 業務員登錄證字號, 業務員姓名
    COMCODE,HANDLER1CODE,HANDLER1NAME,HANDLERIDENTIFYNUMBER,HANDLERNAME
FROM(
	select 
	    H1.insuredName AS INSURED2NAME,--要保人姓名,
	    H1.POSTADDRESS AS POSTADDRESS,--要保人通訊地址,
	    H2.insuredName AS INSURED1NAME,--被保險人姓名,
	    C.licenseNo AS LICENSENO,--車號,
	    M.BUSINESSNATURE AS BUSINESSNATURE,--業務來源,
	    M. EXTRACOMCODE AS EXTRACOMCODE,--單位,
	    M.POLICYNO AS VPLYNO,--前期任意險保單號碼,
	    TO_CHAR(M.ENDDATE, 'yyyyMMdd') AS VENDDATE,--任意險保到期日,
	    '' AS CPLYNO,--前期強制險保單號碼,
	    '' AS CENDDATE,--強制險保到期日,
	    M.comCode AS COMCODE,--歸屬單位代號,
	    M.handler1Code AS HANDLER1CODE,--服務人員員編,
	    M.handler1Name AS HANDLER1NAME,--服務人員姓名,
	    M.handlerIdentifyNumber AS HANDLERIDENTIFYNUMBER,--業務員登錄證字號,
	    M.handlerName AS HANDLERNAME --業務員姓名
	from PRPCMAIN M
	inner join prpCinsured H1 on H1.policyno=M.policyno and H1.INSUREDFLAG='2'
	inner join prpCinsured H2 on H2.policyno=M.policyno and H2.INSUREDFLAG='1'
	inner join prpCitemCar C on C.policyno=M.policyno
	where TO_CHAR(M.ENDDATE,'YYYYMMDD') between '20250105' and '20250105' and M.riskcode in ('A01')
	UNION ALL
	select 
	    H1.insuredName AS INSURED2NAME,--要保人姓名,
	    H1.POSTADDRESS AS POSTADDRESS,--要保人通訊地址,
	    H2.insuredName AS INSURED1NAME,--被保險人姓名,
	    C.licenseNo AS LICENSENO,--車號,
	    M.BUSINESSNATURE AS BUSINESSNATURE,--業務來源,
	    M. EXTRACOMCODE AS EXTRACOMCODE,--單位,
	    '' AS VPLYNO,--前期任意險保單號碼,
	    '' AS VENDDATE,--任意險保到期日,
	    M.POLICYNO AS CPLYNO,--前期強制險保單號碼,
	    TO_CHAR(M.ENDDATE, 'yyyyMMdd') AS CENDDATE,--強制險保到期日,
	    M.comCode AS COMCODE,--歸屬單位代號,
	    M.handler1Code AS HANDLER1CODE,--服務人員員編,
	    M.handler1Name AS HANDLER1NAME,--服務人員姓名,
	    M.handlerIdentifyNumber AS HANDLERIDENTIFYNUMBER,--業務員登錄證字號,
	    M.handlerName AS HANDLERNAME --業務員姓名
	from PRPCMAIN M
	inner join prpCinsured H1 on H1.policyno=M.policyno and H1.INSUREDFLAG='2'
	inner join prpCinsured H2 on H2.policyno=M.policyno and H2.INSUREDFLAG='1'
	inner join prpCitemCar C on C.policyno=M.policyno
	where TO_CHAR(M.ENDDATE,'YYYYMMDD') between '20250105' and '20250105' and M.riskcode in ('B01')
) A
group by 
A.INSURED2NAME,--要保人姓名,
A.POSTADDRESS,--要保人通訊地址,
A.INSURED1NAME,--被保險人姓名,
A.LICENSENO,--車號,
A.BUSINESSNATURE,--業務來源,
A.EXTRACOMCODE,--單位,
A.COMCODE,--歸屬單位代號,

A.HANDLERNAME --業務員姓名

function checkBeyondSumAmount() {
	var flag = true;
	var errorMessage = "";
	var $Amount = $("#ClaimLoss").find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossAmount']");
	var $LossFeeType = $("#ClaimLoss").find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossLossFeeType']");
	var $KindCode = $("#ClaimLoss").find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossKindCode']");
	var $ItemKindNo = $("#ClaimLoss").find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossItemKindNo']");
	
	var amountArray = new Array();
	var kindCodeArray = new Array();
	var sumClaimArray = new Array();
	var payoutTimeArray = new Array();
	var kindCodes = "";
	$("#ClaimLoss").find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossSumClaim']").each(function(i,n){
		if(!$.isNumeric(n.value)){
			n.value = "0";
		}
		if (parseFloat(n.value) < 0) {
			errorMessage += "第"+(i+1)+"條"+i18n.claim.lessZero; // 估损金额不能小於零
			flag = false;
			return flag;
		}
		var $sumClaimList = $(":input[name='"+$KindCode[i].value +"_"+ $ItemKindNo[i].value+"']");
		$Amount[i].value = $sumClaimList.val();
		var $span = $sumClaimList.parents("span[name='spanPayoutTime']");
		var $payoutTime = $span.find(":input[name='payoutTime']");
		if($LossFeeType.get(i).value=="P"){
			kindCodes = $KindCode.get(i).value;
			var index = $.inArray(kindCodes, kindCodeArray);
			if(index>-1){
				sumClaimArray[index] += parseFloat(n.value);
			}else{
				kindCodeArray.push(kindCodes);
				amountArray.push(parseFloat($Amount.get(i).value));
				sumClaimArray.push(parseFloat(n.value));
				payoutTimeArray.push($payoutTime.val());
			}
		}
	});
	$.each(kindCodeArray,function(i,n){
		if(payoutTimeArray[i]!="P"&&$.isNumeric(payoutTimeArray[i])){
			if(sumClaimArray[i]>amountArray[i]*parseFloat(payoutTimeArray[i])){
				errorMessage += kindCodeArray[i]+"險別賠付預估金額應小於等於 ‘保險金額×保額賠付倍數’請檢核後重新輸入。"; //估损金额不能大於保额
				flag = false;
				return false;
			}
		}
		
	});
	if(errorMessage != ""){
		alert(errorMessage);
	}
	return flag;
}

function queryPaymentType(field,codeType){
	var $tr = $(field).parents("tr[name='prpLpersonFeeLossPaymentTr']");
	var $contractingScope = $tr.find(":input[name='prpLpersonLossContractingScope']");
	var isCreate = true;
	if($contractingScope.val()==""){
		isCreate = false;
	}
	if(isCreate&&codeType=="paymentType1"){
		if($tr.find(":input[name='prpLpersonLossPaymentType']").val()==""){
			isCreate = false;
		}
	}
	if(isCreate&&codeType=="paymentType2"){
		if($tr.find(":input[name='prpLpersonLossPaymentType1']").val()==""){
			isCreate = false;
		}
	}
    if (isCreate) {
    	fieldIndex = getElementIndexInForm(document.forms[0], field);
    	setTimeout(function(){
    		createRequestType(field,codeType);
    	},100);
    }else{
    	//隐藏弹出的DIV
 
       hidePopdiv();
    }
}

	        basePath = basePath1 + "prpins/quotation/common/other/excel/temp/quotationExcel";

	        String fileName="";

	        	fileName=batchNo+"_layoutC.txt";
	    	}else{ //機車
	    		// mantis：CAR0453，處理人員：DP0714，核心強制險明信片第一次通知導出規則變更
	    		fileName=batchNo+"_layoutM.txt";
	    	}
	         //指定目录下创建文件夹
	        File file = new File(basePath);

			} 
	        String path = basePath+"/" + fileName;

					if(i>0){
						fw.write("\r\n");
					}
					fw.write(data.get(i));
				}
				fw.close();
			} catch (UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
			} catch (FileNotFoundException e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
			} catch (IOException e) {
				e.printStackTrace();
			} 
	        jsonObject.put("path", basePath);
	        jsonObject.put("fileName", fileName);
		}
		
        jsonObject.put("flag", dataNum == 0 ? "2" : "1");
        jsonObject.put("dataNum", dataNum);
       
        this.renderHtml(jsonObject.toString());
        return NONE;
	}

	/**
	 * 获取险种代码，强制险，任意险种 AL-任意險/ BL-強制險/ TL-任意險失竊車
	 * 非车险，直接用riskCode
	 * @param riskCode
	 * @param damageCode 任意险出险原因
	 * @return
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public String getRiskCode(String policyNo, Map<String,Object>infoMap) throws Exception {
		String codeType = null;
		PrpCmain prpCmain = prpCmainService.findByPrimaryKey(policyNo);
		if(prpCmain!=null){
			if("D".equals(ConstantCodes.carClassMap.get(prpCmain.getRiskCode()))){
				codeType = "AL";
				List<PrpCitemKind> prpCitemKinds = prpCitemKindService.findByConditions("policyno = '" + policyNo + "'");
				if (!CommonUtils.isEmpty(prpCitemKinds)) {
					for (PrpCitemKind prpCitemKind : prpCitemKinds) {
						String kindCode = prpCitemKind.getKindCode();
						if (getBLKindList().contains(kindCode)) {
							codeType = "BL";
							break;
						}else if(getTLKindList().contains(kindCode)) {
							codeType = "TL";
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				if("TL".equals(codeType)&&infoMap!=null){
					String damageCode = (String) infoMap.get("damageCode");
					if(!getDamageCodeTLList().contains(damageCode)){
						codeType = "AL";
					}
				}
			}else{
				codeType = prpCmain.getRiskCode();
			}
		}else{
			codeType = policyNo;
		}
		return codeType;
	}

function dataCheck(field){

		var $curr = $(field);
		var $prpLlossObject = $(field).parents("tr[name='prpLlossObject']");
		var kindCode = $prpLlossObject.find(":input[name='prpLlossDtoKindCode']").val(); //险别
		var kindName = $prpLlossObject.find(":input[name='prpLlossDtoKindName']").val(); //险别
		var sumDefPay = $prpLlossObject.find(":input[name='prpLlossDtoSumDefPay']").val(); //核定赔偿
		var compelPay = $prpLlossObject.find(":input[name='prpLlossDtoCompelPay']").val(); //强制险给付金额
		var sumRest = $prpLlossObject.find(":input[name='prpLlossDtoSumRest']").val(); //剔除金额、残值
		var depreRate = $prpLlossObject.find(":input[name='prpLlossDtoDepreRate']").val(); //折旧率
		var dutyDeductibleRate = $prpLlossObject.find(":input[name='prpLlossDtoDutyDeductibleRate']").val(); //自负额比例
		var deductible = $prpLlossObject.find(":input[name='prpLlossDtoDeductible']").val(); //自负额
		var indemnityDutyRate = $prpLlossObject.find(":input[name='prpLlossDtoIndemnityDutyRate']").val(); //肇事責任比率
		var policyNo = $(":input[name='prpLdangerPolicyNo']").val(); //保单号;
		if (kindCode != '' && sumDefPay != '' && !isNaN(sumDefPay)) { //核定赔偿为0，不继续下去
			var $sumRealPay = $prpLlossObject.find(":input[name='prpLlossDtoSumRealPay']");
			if (parseFloat(sumDefPay) != 0) {
			    var result=true;
				var jsonData= (function(){
					$.ajax({
						url:contextRootPath + "/compensate/calPrpLlossRealpay.do?policyNo="+policyNo+
						"&kindCode="+kindCode+
						"&kindName="+kindName+
						"&sumDefPay="+sumDefPay+
						"&compelPay="+compelPay+
						"&compelPay="+compelPay+
						"&sumRest="+sumRest+
						"&depreRate="+depreRate+
						"&dutyDeductibleRate="+dutyDeductibleRate+
						"&deductible="+deductible+
						"&indemnityDutyRate="+indemnityDutyRate,
		 				async : false,
		 				cache : false,
		 				dataType: "json",
		 				contentType: "application/json; charset=utf-8",
							success: 
						function (data) {
							if (data.prpLloss != null) {
								var prpLlossDto = data.prpLloss;
								if (checkLimit(kindCode, "0", Math.round(prpLlossDto.sumRealPay), "")) { //超出限额
									result = false;
								}
							} else if (data.errorMessage != null) {
								alert(data.errorMessage);
								window.setTimeout(function () {
									$curr.focus();
								});
								result = false;
							}
						}
					});
					//alert("rtn:"+result);
				    return result;
				})();
				//alert("jsonData:"+jsonData);
				return jsonData;
			}
		}
		return true;

/**
 * 手动输入险别代号的onchange事件
 * @param field
 */
function changee(field){
	var rationCode = field.value;
	if(rationCode=='TB'){
		    document.getElementById('startDateTitle').style.display="none";
		    document.getElementById('startDateContent').style.display="none";
			document.getElementById('prpCmain.startDate').value=convertFullDateToString();
			document.getElementById('prpCmain.endDate').value=getNextYearFullDate(convertFullDateToString(), 1);
			//REF赋值
			document.getElementById('prpCmain.descriptions').value="IN FAVOR OF"
	}else{
	    document.getElementById('startDateTitle').style.display="";
	    document.getElementById('startDateContent').style.display="";
		document.getElementById('prpCmain.startDate').value = "";
		document.getElementById('prpCmain.endDate').value = "";
		//REF清空
		document.getElementById('prpCmain.descriptions').value=""
	}
}

function businessCategAttrChg(field){
	var bussinesscateg = $(field).parent().find("select[name*='prpCaddress.businessCateg']");
	if($(field).attr('checked') == "checked"){
		bussinesscateg.attr("disabled",false);
	}else{
		bussinesscateg.attr("disabled","disabled");
		bussinesscateg.val("");
		cleanFR3();
	}
}

/**
	 * 核损不通过的案件不能进入实赔理算 返回值 true 已出 false 未出
	 * @param httpServletRequest 返回给页面的request
	 * @param claimNo 赔案号
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public boolean checkVerifyLoss(HttpServletRequest httpServletRequest, String claimNo) throws Exception {
		boolean blnRetrun = true;
		// 根据赔案号码取得对应的报案号码

		String registNo = this.getCodeService().translateBusinessCode(claimNo, false);
		// 取得赔款计算书信息
		QueryRule queryRule = QueryRule.getInstance();
		queryRule.addEqual("id.registNo", registNo);
		List<PrpLverifyLoss> prpLverifyLossList = this.getPrpLverifyLossService().findPrpLverifyLoss(queryRule);
		if (prpLverifyLossList != null && !prpLverifyLossList.isEmpty()) {
			for (PrpLverifyLoss prpLverifyLoss : prpLverifyLossList) {
				if (prpLverifyLoss.getUnderWriteFlag() == null || !prpLverifyLoss.getUnderWriteFlag().trim().equals("1")) {
					blnRetrun = false;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		return blnRetrun;
	}
	
	
	
	@Override
	public String translateBusinessCode(String businessCode, boolean isSearchClaimNo) {
		String buinessNo = "";
		if (CommonUtils.isEmpty(businessCode)) {
			return buinessNo;
		}
		String statement = null;
		if (isSearchClaimNo) {
			statement = "Select claimno from prplclaim Where registno='" + businessCode + "'";
		} else {
			statement = "Select registno from prplclaim Where claimno='" + businessCode + "'";
		}
		Session session = getHibernateTemplate().getSessionFactory().getCurrentSession();
		List<?> tempList = HibernateUtils.findbySql(session, statement, 0, 0);
		for (int i = 0; i < tempList.size(); i++) {
			buinessNo = (String) tempList.get(i);
		}
		return buinessNo;
	}

function checkSumRealPay(){
	var checkFlag = true;
	$("#PrpLloss").find("tr[name='prpLlossObject']").each(function(){
		var kindCode = $(this).find(":input[name='prpLlossKindCode']").val();
		var kindName = $(this).find(":input[name='prpLlossKindName']").val();
		var sumRealPay =  parseFloat($(this).find(":input[name='prpLlossSumRealPay']").val());
		var $limitObject = $("#limitList").find("div[name='limitObject_"+kindCode+"']");
		if($limitObject.length > 0){
			var limitSumLoss = parseFloat($limitObject.find(":input[name='limitSumLoss']").val());
			var limitSumRealPay = parseFloat($limitObject.find(":input[name='limitSumRealPay']").val());
			if(limitSumLoss - Math.abs(limitSumRealPay) < sumRealPay){
				checkFlag = false;
				var messages = "險別"+kindName;
				messages +="賠款為："+Math.round(limitSumLoss)+"，已追償金額："+Math.round(Math.abs(limitSumRealPay))+"。\r\n";
				messages +="本次實際追償金額不得超過："+(limitSumLoss-Math.abs(limitSumRealPay));
				alert(messages);
				return false;
			}
		}
	});
	return checkFlag;
}

function collectClaimLossNew() { //汇总 保險損失金額 和 責任估損金額 需要统一汇率
	var dutyLoss = 0; //責任估損金額
	var prpLclaimCurrency = $(":input[name='prpLclaimCurrency']").val();
	$("#ClaimLoss").find("tr[name='prpLclaimLossObject']").each(function () {
		var currency = $(this).find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossCurrency']").val(); //损失币别
		var kindCode = $(this).find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossKindCode']").val(); //险别
		var sumLoss = $(this).find(":input[name='prpLclaimLossSumClaim']").val(); //险别估损金额
		if ($.trim(kindCode) != "" && parseFloat(sumLoss) != 0) {
			dutyLoss += (isNaN(sumLoss) ? 0 : parseFloat(getAmount(currency, prpLclaimCurrency, sumLoss)));
		}
	});
	$(":input[name='prpLclaimSumClaim']").val(Math.round(dutyLoss));
}

<script>
function collectHeadName(){
	document.getElementById("hiddenHeadNameArray").value="";
	var countMain = getRowsCount("insertInsuredRow");
	for (j = 0; j < countMain; j++) {
		//insuredNature
		var insuredNature = document.getElementById("prpCinsureds["+j+"].insuredNature").value;
		if(insuredNature == "4"){
			var headName = document.getElementById("prpCinsureds["+j+"].headName").value;
			document.getElementById("hiddenHeadNameArray").value += headName+","
		}
	}
	//insertInsuredIdvRow
	var countIdvMain = getRowsCount("insertInsuredIdvRow");
	for (j = 0; j < countIdvMain; j++) {
		//insuredNature
		var insuredNature = document.getElementById("prpCinsuredIdvLists["+j+"].insuredNature").value;
		if(insuredNature == "4"){
			var headName = document.getElementById("prpCinsuredIdvLists["+j+"].headName").value;
			document.getElementById("hiddenHeadNameArray").value += headName+","
		}
	}
	
}

function checkEndDates(field)
{
	debugger;
	var startDate1=document.getElementById("startDate1").value;
	//mantis：LIA0301，處理人員：DP0713，需求單編號：新核心系統保險期間迄日不得大於起日鎖控
	var fullDatereturn = compareFullDate(field.value,startDate1);
	if(compareFullDate(field.value,startDate1) < 0)
	{
	    getErrorMessage("zj.UIPoEnCarEdit.Enddateearlierdate");//终保日期不得提前于起保日期！
	    var enddate = getNextYearFullDate(startDate1,null);
	    field.value = enddate;
	    field.focus();
	    field.select();
	    return false;
	//mantis：LIA0301，處理人員：DP0713，需求單編號：新核心系統保險期間迄日不得大於起日鎖控 START
	}else if(fullDatereturn == 0 ){
		var classCode=document.getElementById("classCode").value;
		var riskCode = document.getElementById("prpPhead.riskCode").value;
		var startHour = document.getElementById("startHour").value; 
		var endHour="";
		if(riskCode=="TA" || classCode=="C" || classCode=="E"){
			endHour = document.getElementById("endorseParamVOs[0].endHour").value; 
		}else{
			endHour = document.getElementById("endHour").value; 
		}
		if(endHour <= startHour){
			getErrorMessage("zj.UIPoEnCarEdit.Enddateearlierdate");//终保日期不得提前于起保日期！
		    var enddate = getNextYearFullDate(startDate1,null);
		    field.value = enddate;
		    field.focus();
		    field.select();
		    return false;
		}
	//mantis：LIA0301，處理人員：DP0713，需求單編號：新核心系統保險期間迄日不得大於起日鎖控 END
	}

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION BUSINESS.DP0713_TEST(codecode VARCHAR2)
RETURN NUMBER
AS
  iReturn NUMBER;
  CURSOR REC_EXISTS(i VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT 1 FROM tlginsapp.prpmcode WHERE codetype='CarModelNew' and codecode=i ;
BEGIN
 iReturn := 0;
 OPEN REC_EXISTS(codecode);
 FETCH REC_EXISTS INTO iReturn;
 CLOSE REC_EXISTS;
 RETURN iReturn;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE BUSINESS.dp0713_get_customer_by_credit(
    min_credit NUMBER
)
AS 
    c_customers SYS_REFCURSOR;             -- 宣告cursor
BEGIN
    OPEN c_customers FOR                   -- open cursor
        SELECT customer_id, credit_limit, name
        FROM customers
        WHERE credit_limit > min_credit
        ORDER BY credit_limit;
    
    -- 允許cursor當作argument 並回傳結果
    dbms_sql.return_result(c_customers);  
END;


CREATE PROCEDURE getCurrentDate
IS
datevalue DATE;
BEGIN
  SELECT SYSDATE
  INTO datevalue
  FROM dual;
END;

	@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
	private void parameterHandler() throws SystemException, Exception {
		String strDate = (String)getPageInfo().getFilter().get("sDate");
		strDate = rocToAd(strDate, "/");
		if(strDate != null && strDate.length() > 0) {
			strDate += " 00:00:00";
			strDate += " 00:00:00";
			strDate += " 00:00:00";
			getPageInfo().getFilter().put("startCreateDate", strDate);
		}else {
			getPageInfo().getFilter().remove("startCreateDate");
		}
		
		strDate = (String)getPageInfo().getFilter().get("eDate");
		strDate = rocToAd(strDate, "/");
		if(strDate != null && strDate.length() > 0) {
			strDate += " 23:59:59";
			getPageInfo().getFilter().put("endCreateDate", strDate);
		}else {
			getPageInfo().getFilter().remove("endCreateDate");
		}
	}

/**
 * 確認小數位後
 * mantis：LIA0295，處理人員：DP0713，需求單編號：因IFRS17專案小組與再保部捞取資料之相關事宜，調整外幣相關欄位
 */
function checkNumberFormat(field){
	if(field.value.indexOf(".")!=-1){
		var lastObj = field.value.substring(field.value.length-1, field.value.length);
		if(lastObj=='.'){//最後是小數點  刪掉
			field.value=field.value.substring(0, field.value.length-1);
		}
		//小數點後超過四位 刪除
		var overPoint = 4;
		if(field.value.length - (field.value.indexOf(".")+1) > overPoint){
			field.value=field.value.substring(0,(field.value.indexOf(".")+1)+overPoint);
		}
	}
}

	/**
	 * 更具保单年份生成单号
	 * @param iTableName 表名
	 * @param iRiskCode 险别
	 * @param infoMap 条件，包含出险原因，保单号码
	 * @return 返回生成的单号
	 * @throws Exception
	 */
	public String getNoByPolciyYear(String iTableName, String iRiskCode, Map<String,Object>infoMap) throws Exception {
			int iYear = 0;
			String iComCode = "";
			String policyNo = (String) infoMap.get("policyNo");
			try {
				PrpCmain prpCmain = prpCmainService.findByPrimaryKey(policyNo);<<<<<<這裡取得PRPCmain
				if(null!=prpCmain.getComCode()&&!"".equals(prpCmain.getComCode())){
					iComCode = prpCmain.getComCode();
				}
				if("prplclaim".equals(iTableName)){
					if("D".equals(ConstantCodes.carClassMap.get(prpCmain.getRiskCode()))){
						DateTime dataTime = new DateTime(prpCmain.getStartDate());
						iYear = dataTime.getYear();
					}else{
						String registNo = (String) infoMap.get("registNo");
						PrpLregist prpLregist = prpLregistService.findPrpLregist(registNo);
						DateTime dataTime = new DateTime(prpLregist.getReportDate());
						iYear = dataTime.getYear();
					}
				}else{
					DateTime dataTime = new DateTime(prpCmain.getStartDate());<<<<<<<<<<<<<<這裡(prplregist iYear 年份 prpCmain.startdate)
					iYear = dataTime.getYear();
				}
			} catch (Exception e) {
				iYear = DateTime.current().getYear();
			}
			if ("prplcompensate".equals(iTableName)||"prplReplevy".equals(iTableName)) {
				return this.getNo(iTableName, iRiskCode, iComCode, iYear, "", infoMap);
			}else{
				return this.getNo(iTableName, policyNo, iComCode, iYear, "", infoMap);
			}
	}

function checkPayObjectInfo(){

	$("input[name='prpLchargeAreaCode']").each(function (i) {
		var areaCode = $(this).val(); //郵遞區號

			checkFlag = false;
			return false; 
		}
    });
	if(checkFlag){
		$("[name='PrpLpayObjectInfo']").find("tr[name='AreaInfo']").each(function (i) {
			var areaCode = $(this).find(":input[name='prpLpayObjectInfoAreaCode']").val(); //郵遞區號

				checkFlag = false;
				return false; 
			}
	    });
	}
	return checkFlag;

function ajaxAction(action,value){
		//取出ajax xml相對路徑
		var contextPath = '<%=request.getScheme()%>' + '://<%=request.getServerName()+":"+request.getServerPort()+request.getContextPath()%>';
		var path = '';
		var	data = new FormData($('#mainForm')[0]);
		if(action == 'verifyBasicData'){
	    	path = contextPath + '/aps/ajax012/verifyBasicData.action?checkType='+value;
		}
		//執行ajax
		$.ajax({
			url : path,
			type: 'POST',
			data: data,
			dataType: 'json',
			timeout: 10000,
			contentType: false,
			processData: false,
			async: async,
			cache: false,
			error: function (data, status, e){
				ajaxError(data, status);
			},
			success: function (data, status){
				ajaxSuccess(action, data);
			}
		});

function checkBiddingBusiness(){
	//如果不是批改，则不需要做此操作
	if(document.getElementsByName('busiType')[0].value != 'PG') {
		if(document.getElementById("prpCmain.policySort").value!="M"){
			//非主辦業務可追朔保期60天
			if(document.getElementById("prpCmain.coinsFlag").value == "0"){
				var startDate = document.getElementById("prpCmain.startDate").value;
				var nowDate = new Date();
				var year=parseInt(nowDate.getFullYear(),10)-1911;
				var month=parseInt(nowDate.getMonth(),10)+1;
				var day=parseInt(nowDate.getDate(),10);
				var nowDt=Date.parse(month+'/'+day+'/'+year);
				//因減了1911，getTime()會是負值，所以較早的日期放前面才能得出正值
				var dayCount = dateDiff(new Date(replace(startDate,"-","/")),new Date(nowDt),"D");
				if(dayCount > 60){
					getErrorMessage('保期起日超過系統日60天');
					return false;
				}
			}else{
				var startDate = document.getElementById("prpCmain.startDate").value;
				var nowDate = new Date();
				var year=parseInt(nowDate.getFullYear(),10)-1911;
				var month=parseInt(nowDate.getMonth(),10)+1;
				var day=parseInt(nowDate.getDate(),10);
				var nowDt=Date.parse(month+'/'+day+'/'+year);
				//因減了1911，getTime()會是負值，所以較早的日期放前面才能得出正值
				var dayCount = dateDiff(new Date(replace(startDate,"-","/")),new Date(nowDt),"D");
				if(dayCount > 90){
					getErrorMessage('保期起日超過系統日60天');
					return false;
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return true;
}

	/**
	 * 中介审核代码生成规则 机构代码(3)+通路别(2)+5位流水   
	 * 根据通路別和機構代碼模糊查詢出數據的總條數不準確，
	 * 故改為根據通路別和機構代碼模糊查詢且降序排序得到最大的流水碼
	 * author YH
	 * @return
	 * @throws Exception 
	 */
	public static String GetAgentCode(String comCode,String channelType) throws Exception{
		String agentCode="";
		String conditions="";
		String maxAgentCode="";
		String comCodeTemp="";
		if(comCode.length()==3){
			comCodeTemp=comCode;
		}else{
			comCodeTemp=comCode+"0";
		}
		conditions = " agentCode like '" + comCodeTemp + channelType+"%' order by agentCode desc";
		PrpDagentService service = (PrpDagentService)ServiceFactory.getService("prpDagentService");
		List<Prpdagent> prpdagents = service.findAgentListBySql(QueryRule.getInstance().addSql(conditions));
		if (prpdagents.size()!= 0) {
			maxAgentCode = prpdagents.get(0).getAgentCode().substring(5);
		}else {
			maxAgentCode =agentCode + "00000";
		}
		
		Integer newNum = Integer.parseInt(maxAgentCode) + 1;
		agentCode = newNum.toString();
		if (agentCode.length()==1) {
			agentCode="0000"+agentCode;
		}else if (agentCode.length()==2) {
			agentCode="000"+agentCode;
		}else if (agentCode.length()==3) {
			agentCode="00"+agentCode;
		}else if (agentCode.length()==4) {
			agentCode="0"+agentCode;
		}
		
		agentCode=comCodeTemp+channelType+agentCode;
		return agentCode.toUpperCase();
	}

	public String getPrpDriskClauseKind(String riskCode,String kindCode) {
		try {
			StringBuffer hql = new StringBuffer("select KINDCODE,KINDNAME from CCICDMS.prpDriskClauseKind  where RISKCODE = ? and kindCode = ? and validInd ='1'");
			List<Object[]> list = super.findBySql(hql.toString(), riskCode, kindCode);
			if(list != null && list.size() > 0){
				return (String) list.get(0)[1] ;
			}
			
		} catch (Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		}

		return "";
	}

@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
	public Map<String, String> listCodes(String codeType, String riskCode,
			String language) {
		String key = cacheManager.generateCacheKey("listCodes", codeType,
				riskCode, language);
		Object result = cacheManager.getCache(key);
		result=null;<===================================================
		if (result != null) {
			return (Map<String, String>) result;
		}
		if(codeType.equals("ArrangeType")){<===================================================
			System.out.print("d");
		}

		TreeMap<String, String> map = new TreeMap<String, String>();
		if (DMS_FLAG) {
			try {
				List list = getListFromDMS(codeType, riskCode, language, "asc",
						null);
				map = getResultMap(map, list, codeType, language);
			} catch (Exception e) {
				// System.out.println("------代码类型:" + codeType + ", 险种代码: "
				// + riskCode + ", 错误信息:" + e.getMessage());
			}
		} else {
			String hql = generateListHql(codeType, riskCode, language, "asc");
			List list = this.findByHql(hql);
			int forListSize = list.size();
			Object[] arrValue = null;
			for (int i = 0; i < forListSize; i++) {
				arrValue = (Object[]) list.get(i);
				String code = ((String) arrValue[0] + "").trim();
				String name = ((String) arrValue[1] + "").trim();
				map.put(code, name);
				arrValue = null;
			}
			// System.out.println("------listCodes 改为从本地获取数据 codeType: "
			// + codeType);
		}
		cacheManager.putCache(key, map);
		return map;
	}

function onchangeHandler() {
	//add by linzhongxia alert("onchangeHandler-----190");
	if (this.oldOnchange_endorse != null) {
	//add by linzhongxia 	alert(197);
		this.oldOnchange_endorse.call(this);
	}
	if (this.oldOnblur_endorse != null) {
		this.oldOnblur_endorse.call(this);
	}
	if(this.oldOnfocus != null){
		this.oldOnfocus.call(this);
	}
	setOnchangeForField(this);
}


/** 
 * 全局onchange事件处理函数
 * 
 * 	为输入域添加onchange事件
 * 		添加marked属性的作用是：记录当前域是否被修改，例：当域的值从A->B->C时，仍然处于被修改状态
 */
function setOnchangeForField(field) {
	//add by linzhongxia
	if(!field) {
		field = this;
	}
	if(EndorseMode.isClosed()) {
		return;
	}
	//元素是删除或添加,则直接返回
	if (field.style.backgroundColor.toUpperCase() == BGCOLOR_I 
			|| field.style.backgroundColor.toUpperCase() == BGCOLOR_D) {
		return ;
	}
	if (field.type == "select-one") {
		setOnchangeForSelect(field);
	} else if (field.type == "checkbox") {
		setOnchangeForCheckBox(field);
	} else if (field.type == "radio") {
		setOnchangeForRadio(field);
	} else {
		setOnchangeForCommon(field);
	}
}


/** 为普通input框添加事件 */
function setOnchangeForCommon(field){
	//if(field.id=="prpCcommissions[0].costFee"){	debugger;}

	//add by linzhongxia alert(326);
//	var msg = '';
//	if(field.name == "itemKindInfos[0].prpCitemKind.premium")
//		msg += ("before ---- " + field.name + "   " + field.marked + "    " + field.style.backgroundColor);
	if (isValueEqualsTitle(field)) {
		if (field.marked == true) {
			field.marked = false;
			handleFieldValueChange(field, "");
		}
	} else {
		field.marked = true;
		handleFieldValueChange(field, BGCOLOR_U);
	}
//	if(field.name == "itemKindInfos[0].prpCitemKind.premium") {
//		msg += ("after ---- " + field.name + "   " + field.marked + "    " + field.style.backgroundColor);
//	}
//  alert(msg);
}



/** 元素修改变化后的一些列设置 */
function handleFieldValueChange(field, bgcolor) {
	//add by linzhongxia alert("handleFieldValueChange----元素修改变化后的一些列设置");
	//设置计数器
	setFieldCounter(field, bgcolor);
	//设置Flag
	setMultiLineTrFlag(field);
	//设置页面上"批改类型记录"隐藏域的值
	setElValueOnPage();
	//设置页面上“批改要素记录”隐藏域的值 add by sunjiuhua 20110921
	setEndorElementsValue(field, bgcolor);
	//设置背景颜色
	if(field.style.backgroundColor.toUpperCase() == BGCOLOR_ERROR) {
		return;
	}
	field.style.backgroundColor = bgcolor;
}

/** 设置多行输入框的Flag */
 function setMultiLineTrFlag(field){
 	var index=-1;
 	if(field.name!=null && field.name.indexOf("itemKindInfos") != -1){
 		index = field.name.substr(field.name.indexOf("[")+1,1);
 	}
 	
 	if(index == 0){
 		var flagColor = document.getElementById("itemKindInfos["+index+"].prpCitemKind.flag").value;
 		if(flagColor!='I'){
 		 	//看field是否在多行输入框中
 		 	var mulLineflag = isFieldInMultiLine(field);
 		 	if(field.name!=undefined){
 		 	   	var modifyCount = document.getElementById("itemKindRowCount"+index+".modifyCount").value;
 		 	}	
 		 	if(!mulLineflag){
 		 		//如果不是多行输入框，则判断元素对应的flag是否存在，如果存在，则设置flag的值
 		 		var flagField = getRelatedFlagField(field);
 		 
 		 		if(flagField == null) {
 		 			return;
 		 		}
 		 		var flagMark = null;
 		 		if(flagField.fieldCounter >= 1) {
 		 			flagMark = MARK_U;
 		 		} else {
 		 			flagMark = "";
 		 		}
 		 		
 		 		setEndorseFlagValue(flagField, flagMark);
 		 		return;
 		 	}
 		 	var row = null;
 		 	//如果是多行列表中的元素，则获取对应的行
 		 	row = getTR(field);
 		 	//获取该行的Flag元素（必须保证一定有）
 		 	var name = getFlagELName(row);
 		 	//获取flag输入域
 		 	var flagField = document.getElementsByName(name)[0];
 		 	//如果flag第一位为B或D，则表明该行已经被删除，不设置flag的值
 		 	if(flagField.value != null 
 		 		&& (flagField.value.substring(0, 1) == MARK_B || flagField.value.substring(0, 1) == MARK_D)) {
 		 		return;
 		 	}
 		 	var flagMark = null;
 		 	//如果是多行，则看行计数器是否为0
 		 	//alert(row.rowCounter);
 		 	if(!isNaN(row.rowCounter)){
	 		 	if( row.rowCounter >= 1){
	 		 		debugger;
	 				modifyCount = parseInt(modifyCount) + 1;
	 				if(field.name!=undefined){
	 		   			document.getElementById("itemKindRowCount"+index+".modifyCount").value = modifyCount;
	 				}
	 		 	} else {
	 				modifyCount = modifyCount -1 ;
	 				if(field.name!=undefined){
	 		   			document.getElementById("itemKindRowCount"+index+".modifyCount").value = modifyCount;
	 				}
	 		 	}
	 		 	row.rowCounter=1;
 		 	}
 		 	//为flag第一位赋值
 		 	//setEndorseFlagValue(flagField, flagMark);
 			if(modifyCount > 0){
 				setEndorseFlagValue(flagField, MARK_U);
 			}else{
 				setEndorseFlagValue(flagField, MARK_BLANK);
 			}
 		}
 	}else{
 		//看field是否在多行输入框中
 		var mulLineflag = isFieldInMultiLine(field);
 		//if(field.name != null && field.name.indexOf("prpCitemShips") != -1) {alert(field.name + "   " + mulLineflag);}
 		if(!mulLineflag){
 			//如果不是多行输入框，则判断元素对应的flag是否存在，如果存在，则设置flag的值
 			var flagField = getRelatedFlagField(field);
 			if(flagField == null) {
 				return;
 			}
 			var flagMark = null;
 			if(flagField.fieldCounter >= 1) {
 				flagMark = MARK_U;
 			} else {
 				flagMark = "";
 			}
 			
 			setEndorseFlagValue(flagField, flagMark);
 			return;
 		}
 		var row = null;
 		//如果是多行列表中的元素，则获取对应的行
 		row = getTR(field);
 		//获取该行的Flag元素（必须保证一定有）
 		var name = getFlagELName(row);
 		//获取flag输入域
 		var flagField = document.getElementsByName(name)[0];
 		//如果flag第一位为B或D，则表明该行已经被删除，不设置flag的值
 		if(flagField.value != null 
 			&& (flagField.value.substring(0, 1) == MARK_B || flagField.value.substring(0, 1) == MARK_D)) {
 			return;
 		}
 		var flagMark = null;
 		//如果是多行，则看行计数器是否为0
 		if( row.rowCounter >= 1){
 			//如果不为0，则flag第一位为U
 			flagMark = MARK_U;
 		} else {
 			//如果为0，则flag第一位为空
 			flagMark = MARK_BLANK;
 		}
 		//为flag第一位赋值
 		setEndorseFlagValue(flagField, flagMark);
 			
 	}
 	
  }

mantis： FIR0446，處理人員： DP0713 ，需求單編號： 商火-調整商綜文號改由抓取系統設定
NOTE#抓 NOTE#PRPDCLAUSEREPORT

	/**
	 * mantis： FIR0446，處理人員： DP0713 ，需求單編號： 商火-調整商綜文號改由抓取系統設定
	 * @param riskCode 
	 * @param clauseCode 
	 * @param invaliddate 
	 */
	public PrpDclauseReport getReportRiskNameFromPrpdclausereportByInvaliddate(String riskCode,String clauseCode,String invaliddate) {
		try {
			StringBuffer hql = new StringBuffer("select RISKNAME ,REPORTNO from CCICDMS.PRPDCLAUSEREPORT where PRINTSIGN ='1' AND RISKCODE = ? and CLAUSECODE = ? ");
			hql.append(" and INVALIDDATE >= to_date(?,'yyyy-MM-dd')  ORDER BY VALIDDATE");
			List<Object[]> list = super.findBySql(hql.toString(), riskCode, clauseCode,invaliddate);
			if(list != null && list.size() > 0){
				PrpDclauseReport prpDclauseReport = new PrpDclauseReport();				
				prpDclauseReport.setRiskName((String) list.get(0)[0]);
				PrpDclauseReportId id = new PrpDclauseReportId();
				id.setReportNo((String) list.get(0)[1]);
				prpDclauseReport.setId(id);
				return prpDclauseReport ;
			}
			
		} catch (Exception e) {
			e.printStackTrace();
		}
		return null;
	}

function storeCaret(textEl) {
	//debugger;
	if (textEl.createTextRange){
		textEl.caretPos = document.selection.createRange().duplicate();
	}
}
function insertAtCaret(textEl, text) {
	//debugger;
	if (textEl.createTextRange && textEl.caretPos) {
		var caretPos = textEl.caretPos;
		caretPos.text = caretPos.text.charAt(caretPos.text.length - 1) == ' ' ? text + '' : text;
	} else {
		textEl.value = text;
	}
}
function checkEnter(textEl) {
	storeCaret(textEl);
	var currentEvent = window.event;
	if (currentEvent.keyCode == 13) {
		//debugger;
		insertAtCaret(textEl, "\r\n");
		simulateKey(currentEvent, true, "ArrowRight", "ArrowRight", 39, "up", {shiftKey: true },textEl);
	}
}

function fire(el,evttype,code) {
   if (document.createEvent) {
     var evt = document.createEvent('HTMLEvents');
     evt.initEvent( evttype, false, false);
     evt.charCode= evt.keyCode = code;
     el.dispatchEvent(evt);
   } else if (document.createEventObject) {
     var evt = document.createEventObject();
     evt.charCode= evt.keyCode = code;
     el.fireEvent('on' + evttype, evt);
   }

function checkPrpCmainCargoAgentCode() {
	var result = true;
	var callback = {
		success:function(res) {
	       	result = YAHOO.lang.JSON.parse(res.responseText); 
			var message = result.message;
			if (message == 'N') {
   				alert("找不到理賠代理資料。");
   				document.getElementById("prpCmainCargo.checkAgentCode").value="";
   				document.getElementById("prpCmainCargo.checkAgentCode").focus();
   				result = false;
			}
		},
		failure:function(res) {
			errorMessage("理賠代理檢核失敗，原因：" + res.status + "---" + res.statusText);
			result = false;
		}
	}
	var checkAgentCode = document.getElementById("prpCmainCargo.checkAgentCode").value;
	if (checkAgentCode!='') {
		var transaction = YAHOO.util.Connect.asyncRequest('POST','/prpins/policy/checkPrpLexternalAgency.do?checkAgentCode=' + document.getElementById("prpCmainCargo.checkAgentCode").value, callback, null, false);
	}
	return result;
}

function validateStartDateForF01(){
	var startDate = document.getElementById("prpCmain.startDate").value;// 保險起日
	startDate=parseInt(startDate.substring(0,startDate.indexOf("-")))+1911+startDate.substring(startDate.indexOf("-"));
	var startDate2 = new Date(replace(startDate,"-","/"));
	
	var sysDate = new Date();
	sysDate.setMonth( sysDate.getMonth() - 6 );
	
	if(startDate2 > sysDate){//超過3個月
		return true;
	}
	return false;
}

	/**
	 * FIR0300

	 */
	public List<PrpCengage> prpCengageSortByClauseCode(List<PrpCengage> engageList,final boolean asc,final String source){
		List<PrpCengage> sortList = new ArrayList<PrpCengage>();
		if(engageList.size()>0){
			Collections.sort(engageList, new Comparator<PrpCengage>() {  
	            @Override  
	            public int compare(PrpCengage prpCengage1, PrpCengage prpCengage2) { 
	                if(asc){
	                	System.out.println(source+" ASC");
	                    return prpCengage1.getClauseCode().compareTo(prpCengage2.getClauseCode());  
	                }else{
	                	System.out.println(source+" DESC");
	                    return prpCengage2.getClauseCode().compareTo(prpCengage1.getClauseCode());  
	                }
	            }
	        });
		}
		for(PrpCengage prpCengage : engageList){
			sortList.add(prpCengage);
		}
		return sortList;
	}

 --簽呈流程  把DISTINCT移除可以看到整串霸長
 SELECT DISTINCT wflog.* FROM wflog 
WHERE 
  ((wflog.NODENO <= 3 AND (1 = 1 
        AND (
          wflog.CLASSCODE IN ('F') 
          OR wflog.RISKCODE IN ('F01', 'F02')
        )
  ))) 
  And wflog.LogNo <> 1 
  AND wflog.NodeNo <> 1 
  AND (
    wflog.BusinessType = 'C' 
    OR wflog.BusinessType = 'Y'
  ) 
  AND BusinessNo = 'C180026AFH0000301'

--- 6F0100000000250000009 180026AFH00005 C180026AFH0000501
該案件您為立案經辦人員，核賠人員不能是立案經辦人！ --不小心用CE009登入打單 所以提不了高階


 --簽呈流程觀察  --上面的都是用180025FAH00002這張保單去跑
 SELECT w.BUSINESSNO,w.NODESTATUS,w.LOGNO,w.NODENO,w.NODENAME,w.OPERATORCODE,w.OPERATORNAME,w.* 
 FROM WFLOG w WHERE w.POLICYNO = '180025FAH00002' ORDER BY w.BUSINESSNO,w.FLOWID,w.LOGNO
 --C180025AFH0000701 跑完審核 所以多出審核通過節點並且把nodeStatus set 0 把上一節點寫完
 --C180026AFH0000501 因為卡了所以只送到第二層 所以觀察1 2層都會把nodestatus變成4 完成的意思 而下一關要跑核賠2級 等待中會變 1
 --C180026AFH0000401 打單後等著1級主官簽呈 所以 1級等待中nodestatus set 1 operatorcode set null
